# AXIA Business Solutions

AXIA Business Solutions is an enterprise IT company based in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia, serving ports and warehouses. It designs, installs and maintains wireless and data infrastructure: pre- and post-sales site surveys, pole installation, cabling design, warehouse management system (WMS) consulting, hardware and software supply, IT consultancy, repairs for handheld and vehicle-mounted terminals (including Honeywell MX7/MX9, Ruggon MT7000, PX501 and Honeywell Thor VM1), and preventive and corrective maintenance. Partner brands include RuggON, Point Mobile, Ubiquiti, Bosch, Tyco and Cisco. The engineering team has direct port working-environment experience, including WiFi handheld terminal rollouts across live operations. AXIA positions itself as a single-vendor point of responsibility from design through support. Office: C-10-10, Oasis Corporate Park, No. 2, Jalan PJU 1A/2, Ara Damansara, 47301 Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. Contact: sales@axiabizsolutions.com, +60 3-7660 9266. Site available in English, Chinese and Malay.
